title: Upgrade AgentBuilderAgent v1.0 to v1.1 (GitHub read-only facts via ToolGate)
summary:
Upgrades AgentBuilderAgent v1.0 to v1.1 by adding GitHub read-only integration (github_read) to enrich proposals with "GitHub Facts" while preserving proposal-only safety invariants.

What changes:
- Adds optional, backward-compatible request fields: github, githubReadMode.
- Adds a minimal async GitHub read-only client (PR list + check-runs).
- Enforces ToolGate evaluate(tool=github_read, effect=read) before any GitHub API call.
- Adds formatting helpers to summarize overlapping PRs and recent CI failures into PullRequestProposal.summary.

Safety:
- No write operations (PR creation/comment/labels/merge) are introduced.
- No secrets are logged; token is read from env only.
- High-risk file omission remains unchanged.

notes: no changes to high-risk file filtering logic

[project]
name = "agent-builder-agent"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "AgentBuilderAgent v1.1: proposal-only skeleton + GitHub read-only facts (ToolGate-gated)"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
  "pydantic>=2.8.0",
  "pyyaml>=6.0.2",
  "httpx>=0.27.0",
  "python-dateutil>=2.9.0",
  "jsonschema>=4.23.0",
  "openai>=1.0.0",
  "agents>=0.0.0"
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0.0", "ruff>=0.5.0"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class TargetV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    repoKind: Literal["monorepo", "single"]
    language: Literal["typescript", "python", "swift"]
    framework: Literal["nextjs", "fastapi", "swiftui", "agents-sdk"]
    runtime: Literal["node20", "python311", "swift59"] = "python311"


class ConstraintsV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    highRiskDomains: list[Literal["infra", "security", "billing", "template"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["infra", "security", "billing", "template"]
    )
    disallowNetwork: bool = True
    proposalOnly: Literal[True] = True


class RepoContextV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    baseBranch: str = "main"
    existingTree: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class GitHubContextV11(BaseModel):
    """v1.1 GitHub read-only context.

    repo: "owner/repo"
    baseRef: commit sha or branch name used for CI facts lookup (defaults to repoContext.baseBranch)
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    repo: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=256)
    baseRef: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=256)


class AgentBuilderRequestV0(BaseModel):
    """v0 contract with v1.0/v1.1 backward-compatible extensions.

    v1.0 additions (optional):
      - toolPolicyVersion: version key forwarded to ToolGate
      - validationMode: controls schema/tests validation behavior

    v1.1 additions (optional):
      - github: GitHubContextV11 (read-only)
      - githubReadMode: off|metadata|metadata+ci

    NOTE: spec content must at least provide name/purpose; steps can be inferred.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    requestId: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=128)
    specFormat: Literal["yaml", "json", "auto"]
    specText: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    specObject: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

    target: TargetV0
    routingProfile: Literal[
        "planner_standard", "codegen_standard", "reviewer_standard", "docgen_standard"
    ] = "codegen_standard"

    constraints: ConstraintsV0 = Field(default_factory=ConstraintsV0)
    repoContext: RepoContextV0 = Field(default_factory=RepoContextV0)

    # v1.0 extensions (optional)
    toolPolicyVersion: Optional[str] = Field(
        default="toolgate_v1",
        description="ToolGate policyVersion used for evaluate calls (v1.0+).",
    )
    validationMode: Literal["none", "schema", "schema+tests"] = Field(
        default="schema",
        description="Validation behavior for v1.0 safe tools.",
    )

    # v1.1 extensions (optional)
    github: Optional[GitHubContextV11] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional GitHub read-only context (v1.1).",
    )
    githubReadMode: Literal["off", "metadata", "metadata+ci"] = Field(
        default="metadata",
        description="GitHub read-only depth (v1.1).",
    )

    def get_spec_payload(self) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[dict[str, Any]]]:
        return self.specText, self.specObject

    @classmethod
    def validate_presence_of_spec(cls, values: "AgentBuilderRequestV0") -> "AgentBuilderRequestV0":
        if not values.specText and not values.specObject:
            raise ValueError("Either specText or specObject is required.")
        return values

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional

import httpx


class GitHubReadError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GitHubReadConfig:
    base_url: str = "https://api.github.com"
    token: Optional[str] = None
    timeout_seconds: float = 20.0


class GitHubReadClient:
    """Minimal GitHub read-only client (v1.1).

    Scope:
    - list open PRs
    - list check-runs for a given ref (commit sha or branch)

    NOTE: This client must be called only after ToolGate allows github_read.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: GitHubReadConfig) -> None:
        self._config = config

    def _headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        h = {
            "accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "user-agent": "toolgate-gated-agentbuilderagent/1.1",
        }
        if self._config.token:
            h["authorization"] = f"Bearer {self._config.token}"
        return h

    async def list_open_prs(self, repo: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        url = f"{self._config.base_url.rstrip('/')}/repos/{repo}/pulls"
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self._config.timeout_seconds) as c:
                r = await c.get(url, headers=self._headers(), params={"state": "open"})
                r.raise_for_status()
                data = r.json()
                if not isinstance(data, list):
                    raise GitHubReadError("Unexpected response for pulls list")
                return data
        except Exception as e:
            raise GitHubReadError(f"GitHub read failed (list_open_prs): {e}") from e

    async def list_check_runs(self, repo: str, ref: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        # GitHub endpoint: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/check-runs
        url = f"{self._config.base_url.rstrip('/')}/repos/{repo}/commits/{ref}/check-runs"
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self._config.timeout_seconds) as c:
                r = await c.get(url, headers=self._headers())
                r.raise_for_status()
                data = r.json()
                runs = data.get("check_runs", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
                if not isinstance(runs, list):
                    return []
                return runs
        except Exception as e:
            raise GitHubReadError(f"GitHub read failed (list_check_runs): {e}") from e

# AgentBuilderAgent (v1.1)

Spec (YAML/JSON) -> skeleton -> PullRequestProposal(JSON)

## v1.0 additions
- ToolGate permission checks (evaluate /v1/evaluate)
- Schema validation scaffolding (jsonschema)
- Existing repo structure hints via repoContext.existingTree

## v1.1 additions
- GitHub read-only facts (ToolGate-gated)
  - overlap PR detection (heuristic)
  - optional CI check-runs failures (metadata+ci)

## Run
```bash
export LLM_ROUTER_URL="http://your-router"
export TOOLGATE_URL="http://your-toolgate"
# Optional for GitHub read-only (recommended: fine-grained token w/ read access)
export GITHUB_TOKEN="..."
python -m agent_builder_agent.cli < request.json
```

## Safety
- proposal-only
- no git write / PR create / merge
- no infra / secret operations
- high-risk files are omitted from proposals
- github_read is read-only and executed only when ToolGate allows

manualSteps: If enabling GitHub facts: set GITHUB_TOKEN with read-only permissions (fine-grained preferred).
Verify that github_read calls are always preceded by ToolGate evaluate(tool=github_read, effect=read).
Confirm no GitHub write endpoints are referenced (no PR create/comment/label/merge).
